title: Instant learning is retention, not identification: the failing run's own values index the fix. On click@1b0e19f505 the human fix is derived from the trace at rank 0 (2 of 119 tests survive) with 5 candidates evaluated, where the text-proximity pool needed a 400-candidate pool to place it at rank 1.

the_answer.retention: Solved, and the tree's law stands: O(machines x adaptation) + O(requests), crossover at the 2nd-3rd request (INSTANT_LEARNING_IN_A_NEW_ENVIRONMENT_20261116_V1). Nothing here contradicts it.
the_answer.identification: Not solved by retention and not solvable by it: one demonstration is the maximum-variance estimator, and a single trace is consistent with exponentially many hypotheses. Repetition of a sample that cannot separate hypotheses cannot separate them.
the_answer.the_claim_that_is_false: "Give it the actions once and everything on a computer is solved." The action vocabulary is not what fails on a computer, and the fix is usually not the site's own expression.
the_answer.why_one_shot_is_only_sound_with_a_verifi: Retention makes a wrong generalization permanent in one step. Where an exact verifier stands at capture (tests, exit codes, state checks) one-shot learning is sound; where the verifier is a glance or a judge model it is a coin flip made permanent.

osworld_2_0.source: OSWorld 2.0: Benchmarking Computer Use Agents on Long-Horizon Real-World Tasks (arXiv 2606.29537, 2026)
osworld_2_0.their_sentence: "The failure is not a missing click; it is stale grounding."
osworld_2_0.reading: The dominant failure is final-state verification and grounding -- identification -- not the ability to operate the GUI. Showing an agent each action once teaches the part that already works.

repair_literature.reading: 2026 repair work has moved to execution-level dynamic information -- traces, variable states, crash paths -- because static context does not identify a fault. All three feed that trace to a model. This round derives the patch from the trace with no model, and measures the difference.

version_space.source: Guiding Program Synthesis by Learning to Generate Examples (ICLR 2020) + version-space algebra; STUN
version_space.reading: A single example leaves an exponential candidate set; the resolution is a distinguishing input that splits the survivors, not another example of the same kind. This tree already has the query machinery (how_many_hypotheses_survive_an_observation_v1, the_experiment_that_identifies_v1).

the_build.mechanism: Run the failing test under sys.settrace, record the value of every pure expression in the file (no calls, so the trace cannot perturb the run), then walk one causal chain: the failure quotes a string -> that string's source is an f-string -> the f-string's argument evaluated to X on that line -> the guard above it let X through -> the fix excludes X there.

the_build.why_rank_0_is_not_luck: The candidate is not near the site by text distance; it is implied by the trace. Proximity found the same fix at rank 1 only because the blamed value is printed one line below the guard; the trace does not care where the print is.

errata.corrected_claim: THE_SITE_IS_NOT_WHERE_THE_FIX_COMES_FROM_20261118_V1 reported "10 of 29 commits have no oracle: the post-fix tests pass on the parent".
errata.what_was_actually_true: Most of those suites never ran. `requests` and `httpx` conftests import urllib3/trustme/uvicorn/trio, tqdm's pyproject sets `filterwarnings = error` so a pytest-asyncio warning became INTERNALERROR, and a changed line that is one entry of a dict literal (`"raw_path": ...`) parsed as nothing at all. An empty verdict map was read as a passing suite.
errata.the_fix: run_tests_full returns the verdicts AND the output; an empty map or a collection error is SUITE_DID_NOT_RUN with the tail recorded; dict-entry fragments are wrapped and parsed; the pytest invocation pins the asyncio fixture loop scope. All three are pinned by tests.
errata.why_it_matters: A wrong NO_ORACLE is a silent success report: it says the project's tests pass on the parent when in fact nothing was executed. It is the same class of defect as the 100% verdict from the shallowest change point.

falsifier.claim: On this population the blame index must identify at least as many commits as the proximity index AND at a lower evaluated-candidate cost.
falsifier.if_false: the index is not the bottleneck; this file is superseded rather than patched.

limits: 11 of 29 commits return NO_BLAME: their failure carries no produced value (transformations, type tests, data constants). That is the next mechanism's target.
8 of 29 could not run their suite under this sandbox's dependency set (SUITE_DID_NOT_RUN), and are counted as neither success nor failure.
2 of 29 blame a value that has no guard above it (NO_GUARD_ABOVE_THE_BLAMED_VALUE).
the blame chain currently only closes when the wrong value is formatted into the message the failure quotes; exceptions, exit codes and non-formatted stdout are not yet blamed.
producer-run sandbox measurement; independent reproduction open.
